title: Mood and energy log
audience: For anyone who wants to see what lifts them and what drains them.
description: An evening mood and energy log. Tell your AI about your day in your own words and it scores and logs it in Pinto Notes.
tagline: An evening check-in that shows patterns.
seoTitle: Mood and energy log template for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
Mood and energy log

A short check-in each evening: add a row, or tell your AI about your day and it logs it. After a few weeks, ask it what the patterns are.

## Patterns

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Mood and energy log". Each evening I'll tell you about my day in my own words. Read the note with fetch, then add one row to the table with edit: Mood and Energy from 1 (low) to 5 (great), Sleep in hours, and one short line in Note. If you're unsure about a score, ask me instead of guessing. When I ask about patterns, add what you notice under "Patterns", and say how many days it rests on. Don't give medical advice.

asks: Ask how my day went and how I slept, then log my mood and energy for today.
What do my best days have in common?
Does a short night change my energy the next day?
